source_root: directory holding the 54 pinned split source files (read only)
model_dir: directory holding the seven pinned checkpoint files
gpu_uuid: GPU-... of the one GPU this role may use
credential_file: server: the key list; edge: the client key. Outside source_root, mode 0600
client_id: the client id the credential pair was generated for
adapter_path: the private adapter file (sha256 pinned in gsel_spec.py)
